root_cause.summary: The cart service is failing to access its Redis storage, causing errors that propagate up to the frontend. Traces show the cart's EmptyCart operation failing with a connection error to Redis, and logs confirm repeated Redis connection failures.

evidence.exception:
Status(StatusCode="FailedPrecondition", Detail="Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis
   at cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected() in /usr/src/app/src/cartstore/ValkeyCartStore.cs:line 103
   at cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EmptyCart
evidence.why_it_matters: Deepest failing span in cart shows FailedPrecondition due to inability to connect to redis

evidence.message: Wasn't able to connect to redis
evidence.why_it_matters: Cart logs error 'Wasn't able to connect to redis' repeated multiple times

proposed_action.reason: Cart service cannot connect to Redis, likely Redis (valkey-cart) is down or unresponsive

timeline.event: Alert received: Error rate elevated on frontend
Earliest cited log line from cart

prevention: Add health checks and auto-restart for Redis to avoid silent failures
